sloka: त्वं सर्वंगुणसम्पन्ना नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम् ।त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी भीरु यौवनं ते निवर्तते ।। ७.१७.२२ ॥
transliteration: tvaṁ sarvaṁguṇasampannā nārhase vaktumīdṛśam ।trailokyasundarī bhīru yauvanaṁ te nivartate ।। 7.17.22 ॥

translations.english: O beautiful-hipped one, you are arrogant to have such a mind; O deer-eyed one, the accumulation of merit shines only for the aged.
